```artifact
Feature: System Security and Functionality

  Scenario: Chemist and Lab Login
    Given a Chemist with username "valid_chemist" and password "valid_password"
    When the Chemist logs into the system
    Then the Chemist should be able to access the Prescriptions
    And the Chemist should not be able to access the Prescriptions of other users

  Scenario: Patient Login
    Given a Patient with username "valid_patient" and password "valid_password"
    When the Patient logs into the system
    Then the Patient should be able to access their Prescriptions
    And the Patient should not be able to access the Prescriptions of other users

  Scenario: Email Notification for Patients
    Given a Patient with username "valid_patient" and password "valid_password"
    When the Patient logs into the system and receives a prescription
    Then an email should be sent to the Patient's email address
    And the email should contain the full prescription and Invoice

  Scenario: Payment Gateway Integration
    Given a Patient with username "valid_patient" and password "valid_password"
    When the Patient logs into the system and attempts to pay using a valid Debit/Credit Card or Net banking
    Then the payment should be processed securely
    And a confirmation message should be displayed to the Patient

  Scenario: Constraint: Django 2.0
    Given the system is running
    When the system checks its framework version
    Then the framework version should be 2.0

  Scenario: Constraint: MySQL
    Given the system is running
    When the system checks its database type
    Then the database type should be MySQL

  Scenario: Constraint: Browser Support
    Given the system is running
    When a user accesses the system using Google Chrome
    Then the system should function correctly

  Scenario: Constraint: Browser Support
    Given the system is running
    When a user accesses the system using Mozilla Firefox
    Then the system should function correctly

  Scenario: Constraint: Browser Support
    Given the system is running
    When a user accesses the system using Safari
    Then the system should function correctly

  Scenario: Constraint: Browser Support
    Given the system is running
    When a user accesses the system using an unsupported browser
    Then the system should display an error message

  Scenario: Constraint: Operating System Support
    Given the system is running
    When a user accesses the system using an operating system that supports the above browsers
    Then the system should function correctly

  Scenario: Constraint: Operating System Support
    Given the system is running
    When a user accesses the system using an operating system that does not support the above browsers
    Then the system should display an error message

  Scenario: Negative Path: Invalid Chemist Login
    Given an invalid Chemist with username "invalid_user" and password "invalid_password"
    When the Chemist attempts to log into the system
    Then the Chemist should not be able to access the system
    And an error message should be displayed

  Scenario: Negative Path: Invalid Patient Login
    Given an invalid Patient with username "invalid_user" and password "invalid_password"
    When the Patient attempts to log into the system
    Then the Patient should not be able to access the system
    And an error message should be displayed

  Scenario: Boundary Path: Maximum Length Username
    Given a Chemist with username "a" repeated 100 times and password "valid_password"
    When the Chemist attempts to log into the system
    Then the Chemist should not be able to access the system
    And an error message should be displayed

  Scenario: Boundary Path: Minimum Length Username
    Given a Chemist with username "a" repeated 5 times and password "valid_password"
    When the Chemist attempts to log into the system
    Then the Chemist should be able to access the system

  Scenario: Boundary Path: Maximum Length Password
    Given a Chemist with username "valid_chemist" and password "a" repeated 100 times
    When the Chemist attempts to log into the system
    Then the Chemist should not be able to access the system
    And an error message should be displayed

  Scenario: Boundary Path: Minimum Length Password
    Given a Chemist with username "valid_chemist" and password "a" repeated 5 times
    When the Chemist attempts to log into the system
    Then the Chemist should be able to access the system

  Scenario: Boundary Path: Special Characters in Username
    Given a Chemist with username "valid_chemist!" and password "valid_password"
    When the Chemist attempts to log into the system
    Then the Chemist should be able to access the system

  Scenario: Boundary Path: Special Characters in Password
    Given a Chemist with username "valid_chemist" and password "valid_password!"
    When the Chemist attempts to log into the system
    Then the Chemist should be able to access the system

  Scenario: Negative Path: Payment Gateway Unavailable
    Given the payment gateway is unavailable
    When a Patient attempts to pay using a valid Debit/Credit Card or Net banking
    Then the payment should not be processed
    And an error message should be displayed

  Scenario: Negative Path: Payment Gateway Unexpected Response
    Given the payment gateway returns an unexpected response
    When a Patient attempts to pay using a valid Debit/Credit Card or Net banking
    Then the payment should not be processed
    And an error message should be displayed
```
